question: Is terminal production-hook proof plus regression coverage sufficient to land this session-state/message-delivery boundary without a live two-agent timing capture?
rationale: The patch is focused and source-backed, but it changes replay filtering at a stateful compaction boundary where the observable bug is timing-dependent and delivery-sensitive.

options.title: Land With Scoped Proof
options.body: Accept the remaining live-timing gap because the PR exercises the production compaction hook and regression-tests replay removal plus safe-text preservation.

options.title: Request Live Two-Agent Proof
options.body: Ask for a real two-agent compaction recovery run showing one delivered reply and preserved safe source context before merge.

options.title: Pause For Boundary Review
options.body: Pause the PR if maintainers want replay safety moved to a broader side-effect, transcript, or API boundary instead of local fallback filtering.

recommendation.title: Land With Scoped Proof
recommendation.body: Accept the remaining live-timing gap because the PR exercises the production compaction hook and regression-tests replay removal plus safe-text preservation.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent compaction and agent-runtime history makes this the strongest routing candidate for the proof and state-boundary decision.
